PDEL.description: P-Delta Analysis Control (PDEL). A single-instance (key 1) analysis control defined by the iteration count, convergence tolerance, and a list of load cases each with a scale factor.

ITER.description: Number of iterations for the P-Delta analysis.

TOL.description: Convergence tolerance for the P-Delta analysis.

PDEL_CASES.description: List of load cases included in the P-Delta analysis. Each LCNAME must reference an existing static load case (STLD) name, otherwise the request is rejected.

LCNAME.description: Load case name; must match an existing static load case (STLD) name.

FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to this load case in the P-Delta analysis.
